title: OpenWOP gap registry
description: Shape of spec/v1/gaps.json (RFC 0166 §B) — one entry per RFC gap-register row, with a globally unique id, a witness class, an optional owning requirement id, the row's disposition, and the source cell it was generated from. Generated by scripts/generate-gaps.mjs; the hand-maintained fields (witness, requirementId, target, note) survive regeneration. Not a wire artifact; deliberately kept out of schemas/.

witnessClasses.description: The closed witness enum (RFC 0166 §C.1) plus `unclassified` for backfilled rows awaiting review; the unclassified count is a ratchet.

requirementId.description: An id in conformance/requirements.json (or its aliases) when the gap has a witnessing test.

target.description: Argument of transferred:/carried:/externally-gated: — RFC, doc path, tripwire, or the gap's own id.

token.description: The row id as written (`G<n>`), which the file must still contain.
